servers.name: obp-mcp
servers._comment: OBP-MCP in consent mode (:9100): Opey authenticates with its own client-credentials token (OPEY_OIDC_TOKEN_URL, OPEY_OIDC_CLIENT_ID, OPEY_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET); the user's consent travels with each tool call. Use forward_bearer_token only for an OBP-MCP in oauth mode that should see the user's own token
